Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Les Misérables", "unit": 251, "heading": "II OÙ LE PETIT GAVROCHE TIRE PARTI DE NAPOLÉON LE GRAND", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "fr81-u251-r0094", "target": "— Вот уж, право, отменный простофиля, — говорил Гаврош.", "source_sha256": "8168201d1d82ebd273a1a50c854d342b2714fde286cf5e9ee690e9245d7dd5a5", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u251-r0094", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "b53380d2f4994c95e6059e79a6963f01d955ef30c425f5bc11b2d30c59744427"}, {"source_id": "fr81-u251-r0095", "target": "Потом, задумчивый, он бормотал сквозь зубы:", "source_sha256": "c5e13d37695f46e90532094a7c419082e2ec5a47b0f6167051d22dd1fec63cac", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u251-r0095", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "9c134f01373054cd80ca1e93dc149ca1c7c82dac0ac5b7859c3460b33f566734"}], "source_language": "French", "part": 4, "book": 6, "chapter": 2, "role": "CHAPTER"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "fr81-u251-r0096", "tag": "prose", "text": "— C’est égal, si j’avais des mômes, je les serrerais mieux que ça.", "sha256": "0d97bdd377d0a075552cd97312a99e6c68d43b6bcd50c1697deefec58a597437", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0097", "tag": "prose", "text": "Comme ils achevaient leur morceau de pain et atteignaient l’angle de cette morose rue des Ballets au fond de laquelle on aperçoit le guichet bas et hostile de la Force :", "sha256": "98b7a0b4f94ba571bc49498bc933dbb93bd331d446156279f94014341e601453", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0098", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Tiens, c’est toi, Gavroche ? dit quelqu’un.", "sha256": "3f3ac1977c2ff61dcad12ff2980bd15a8c4128f8030b580e6a2ab56e278b5163", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0099", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Tiens, c’est toi, Montparnasse ? dit Gavroche.", "sha256": "41a18ae4d48529d6a518a6f5e9f542ba6804ddc0eb85a45f0115fd918ba817a6", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0100", "tag": "prose", "text": "C’était un homme qui venait d’aborder le gamin, et cet homme n’était autre que Montparnasse déguisé, avec des besicles bleues, mais reconnaissable pour Gavroche.", "sha256": "43d159bf45eb5fd1b2f0fcb0291c4827f9599a328e6b78953aec940d3a79345a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0101", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Mâtin ! poursuivit Gavroche, tu as une pelure couleur cataplasme de graine de lin et des lunettes bleues comme un médecin. Tu as du style, parole de vieux !", "sha256": "f4a73961eb1d913bd793fee94b733b1c5841d96a6e86a5b424de94473c2bacaf", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0102", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Chut, fit Montparnasse, pas si haut !", "sha256": "d497ad55c6969408d28fc25458dc47813cd5ee9eb0b62d92c42ccb1d2a2a6d34", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0103", "tag": "prose", "text": "Et il entraîna vivement Gavroche hors de la lumière des boutiques.", "sha256": "46349d2fdf431a10c968421cf07632572ec8a2b3df93ebba09ad98351d9ec7a3", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0104", "tag": "prose", "text": "Les deux petits suivaient machinalement en se tenant par la main.", "sha256": "641b32445d73797bfe888ce4dcce11535f2cda03d653e8cca0c8b1ed9a384128", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0105", "tag": "prose", "text": "Quand ils furent sous l’archivolte noire d’une porte cochère, à l’abri des regards et de la pluie :", "sha256": "a6bc9832cb95cf00ab5fc48795595637b648d0013ee4dddcb0d8c8ee99e4f75f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0106", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Sais-tu où je vas ? demanda Montparnasse.", "sha256": "d24d9a630257da978b5891b4bbfa4fc83efae1a821b498999604e1e28754db2a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0107", "tag": "prose", "text": "— À l’abbaye de Monte-à-Regret[[N2]], dit Gavroche.", "sha256": "2bd76d57b41743d1f45a263aaa6458fba93c7bc4b6253afa6fe2a3313915f8e5", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": ["[[N2]]"]}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0108", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Farceur !", "sha256": "2656c389ea831094caf2d3e2853d6871c8bd0531477496daef3d1c105cd303db", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0109", "tag": "prose", "text": "Et Montparnasse reprit :", "sha256": "174c501e1e086986f0d15bf5ecf064642b42bb2e7ee6d1ce0ba2b22b13227149", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0110", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Je vas retrouver Babet.", "sha256": "1780063aecef818df0fcbc66365465bd6d9b2420b1ed5a38d7a3cf4e939829fe", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0111", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Ah ! fit Gavroche, elle s’appelle Babet.", "sha256": "ed69a73e99a877850002b5c8accd822707c8c90ed5183baf1d40fdfe242685d0", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0112", "tag": "prose", "text": "Montparnasse baissa la voix.", "sha256": "426b71cbd238e5ac9cb86249dcb5ff25f172e24ca50d8008954b250fa48eeae1", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0113", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Pas elle, lui.", "sha256": "abc3e4f8c975b93591555ed2d69e76fff72df00fb6015061dce1a8c0c9c5399b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0114", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Ah, Babet !", "sha256": "7d91e120c03c39876f55d44793f3920365ea8e8446535d9c3c52d51c2199ba2d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0115", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Oui, Babet.", "sha256": "6ad8d26322c119fe6626f61e2b9778d8b7298fcc8b753edaacc1e60c80485f42", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0116", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Je le croyais bouclé.", "sha256": "47401dc7f58274a8e31eebd87d9d4d7b0447bdde21143b50543d66c487b22740", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0117", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Il a défait la boucle, répondit Montparnasse.", "sha256": "7705eba40dd725a4bc08a3eff7807012881453346d23d073efa1dcbd63c38cf7", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0118", "tag": "prose", "text": "Et il conta rapidement au gamin que, le matin de ce même jour où ils étaient, Babet, ayant été transféré à la Conciergerie, s’était évadé en prenant à gauche au lieu de prendre à droite dans le « corridor de l’instruction ».", "sha256": "89ed37d2565949b054c54f2b6be1f4406206151d7cd38c8e194d90d790fc5d7b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0119", "tag": "prose", "text": "Gavroche admira l’habileté.", "sha256": "e51cfcde73e1bcfe00bea8554316750bededad2c0c22ee3b35a81fb5b036707b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0120", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Quel dentiste ! dit-il.", "sha256": "85d1438793f38d3dd9d13a28d166d8490f53338c1378780214e25418c55212e3", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0121", "tag": "prose", "text": "Montparnasse ajouta quelques détails sur l’évasion de Babet et termina par :", "sha256": "a885aeb7d3d51eed04e745ad3644b90b23d4afd0fd26d02f3245354edeb9865f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0122", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Oh ! ce n’est pas tout.", "sha256": "378fc7e68877de73d1d94796a3834adc7741660484c6aed3b6a97e758d262fd6", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0123", "tag": "prose", "text": "Gavroche, tout en écoutant, s’était saisi d’une canne que Montparnasse tenait à la main, il en avait machinalement tiré la partie supérieure, et la lame d’un poignard avait apparu.", "sha256": "5a681ff167896d97e2913bc4230e00162198149aaa7688fa14e1273d4782b5c9", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0124", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Ah ! fit-il en repoussant vivement le poignard, tu as emmené ton gendarme déguisé en bourgeois.", "sha256": "219ff30d75dbd09181985628ed9296785895c65a860cce69c7de9c170c4375a2", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0125", "tag": "prose", "text": "Montparnasse cligna de l’œil.", "sha256": "61b3a5b28ace0446e2da2c2befb5d2d12547798460f553bf4fb6f2d57e99d61c", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0126", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Fichtre ! reprit Gavroche, tu vas donc te colleter avec les cognes ?", "sha256": "920bf13a04a27042718b4cc74cd11122cc034ec71c3440dc76a8eb678a231a0d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0127", "tag": "prose", "text": "— On ne sait pas, répondit Montparnasse d’un air indifférent.
